widgets_values:
A LongLive-2.0 story in nine segments. Each node is one segment: the video follows its prompt for its frames, and segments play in sequence order. The first node picks the model. On each later node, kind sets how the segment enters: a shot blends from the segment before, a cut starts a fresh scene.

The last node feeds Reactor Render, and Reactor Sequence Visualizer, which draws the sequence on a frame ruler as it will play. Edit a segment on its node.

Set your Reactor API key in this plugin's config.ini.
